scope: Decode the ODA-defined 32-bit proxy SUBENT_LINETYPE sentinel values while retaining the existing low-16-bit sentinel values in the same 4-byte RL field. This does not qualify whole-cache replay or native rendering semantics.

odaOpenDesignSpecification.rule: Proxy SUBENT_LINETYPE (type 18) is an RL. 0xFFFFFFFE means BYBLOCK and 0xFFFFFFFF means BYLAYER.

physicalSourceObservation.observation: Every inspected cache contains proxy chunk opcode 18 with a 4-byte payload value 0x00007FFF.

inspection.tool: Temporary local C++ inspector using dwgRW, dx_iface, and DRW_ProxyGraphicDecoder::inspect
inspection.result: 36 records; all 36 contained opcode 18 value 32767; all belonged to *U0.

physicalSourceObservation.limitation: This is a parser-backed byte-stream census, not independent producer or consumer evidence. The DWG source layer and linetype order arrays differ from the dx_iface callback table order (first layer: DWG 0 vs adapter Dim; first linetype: DWG Continuous vs adapter ByLayer), so raw cache table indices cannot be assumed to address emitted DXF tables unchanged.

profiles: 0x00007FFE -> BYBLOCK (existing low-16-bit sentinel value in a 4-byte RL)
0x00007FFF -> BYLAYER (observed AC1021 low-16-bit value in a 4-byte RL)
generatedControl.behavior: Each generated little-endian proxy stream sets SUBENT_LINETYPE and emits a circle; the callback captures the expected lineType.
generatedControl.fixturePolicy: Controls construct cache bytes locally in the test. No DWG/DXF fixture was added.

implementation.change: Map the ODA 32-bit BYBLOCK/BYLAYER sentinel values separately, preserving both existing low-16-bit values in the same 4-byte RL field.
implementation.outputEffect: No cache replay admission or strict-output policy changed.

claimBoundary: This proves bounded decoder sentinel mapping and generated callback behavior only.
It does not prove the complete MLINE proxy-cache schema, source resource-index remapping, cache replay compatibility, or native rendering semantics.
Keep strict output refusal for the 36 physical proxy caches and keep the AC1021 sample unqualified until those gaps have eligible evidence.
